$comment: One entry per distinct PAGE SHAPE, not per route. Every node is a structured object so required/repeatable/variant are machine-enforceable rather than implicit conventions.
routeCoverageNote: 12 real route patterns plus one catch-all = 13 entries, mapped onto 11 templates. Two templates are shared: audience-landing covers /parents + /sitters, legal-prose covers /terms-of-use + /privacy-policy. Each is grouped only after a direct node-sequence diff of the real page components (see each template's sharedByVerification). /blog-posts/:slug is ONE template with 10 real instances. Every route is assigned exactly once — asserted at generation time and re-checked by extraction/verify_all.py.

deliberatelyAbsent./sign-up: Built, then REMOVED on purpose by explicit decision. Must NOT be reintroduced as a template. Homepage CTAs now link to https://app.withotter.com/sign-up.
deliberatelyAbsent./welcome: Same — removed on purpose. Subpage CTAs link to https://app.withotter.com/sign-up/welcome. The two paths genuinely differ per route and must not be normalised.

home.name: Homepage
notes: The only route using the 'home' chrome variant (empty nav link and footer link containers) and the only route with hero.dark-rounded, banner.beta-card, process.numbered-cards, conversion.join-card or trust.press-bar.
process.numbered-cards and conversion.join-card are both inside the same section.how-it-works; the join card is its 4th col-lg-12 column.
Carries the site's ONLY scroll reveal.

audience-landing.name: Audience landing
audience-landing.sharedByVerification: Grouped only after diffing both pages' real node sequences directly in src/pages/Parents.jsx and src/pages/Sitters.jsx: both render PageHero -> section>Tabs -> section>CtaCard -> TestimonialsSlider -> CommonQuestions, in that order, with no extra or missing section on either side. The ONLY structural difference is conversion.cta-card's variant (/parents narrow, /sitters wide), which is why structural rules key on (section, variant) rather than bare id.
notes: Both routes render two genuinely empty CMS collections (the testimonials slider and Common questions). Those grey 'No items found.' boxes are intentional, not missing content.

trust-safety.name: Trust & safety
notes: Shares the PST hero skeleton with audience-landing but diverges completely below it: its whole <main> is ONE section (video facade + 4 cards).
It has no tabs, no CTA card, no testimonials slider and no Common questions — 0 .swiper and 0 .w-dyn-empty on the route.
The only route with two hero CTAs.

faq-categories.name: FAQ categories

nodes.note: Appears exactly twice, consecutively ('For parents' then 'For sitters'). A named exception to NO_ADJACENT_SAME_CATEGORY.

notes: /faq genuinely has NO FAQ content: both CMS collections are empty on the original, the server HTML ships no item template at all, and no accordion is rendered on the route.
The accordion CSS exists in the design system and is used by /careers' job rows, but has zero live instances here.
This is the only template whose hero has no lede and no CTA.

contact.name: Contact
notes: The only route with form inputs anywhere on the marketing site.
The form has method="get" and NO action (Webflow's default). The clone prevents submission and makes no network call.

careers.name: Careers
notes: The longest template: 8 content sections. Node order verified against the spec's measured y-offset table.
stats.grid appears TWICE with DIFFERENT variants — the clearest case for keying structural rules on (section, variant).
The hero CTA is a plain native #jobs anchor jump; no smooth-scroll JS is attached.
jobs.listing-rows holds the site's only Greenhouse outbound links.

blog-index.name: Blog index
notes: The hero section carries .u-p-0, zeroing its padding at all three widths — the only hero that does.
Its image is a bare with no wrapper and no object-fit; the single-candidate srcset plus the original's sizes string are load-bearing, not decoration.
Unlike /faq, no .w-dyn-empty block exists in the original markup for either blog list, so none is rendered.

blog-post.name: Blog post
notes: ONE template, 10 real instances.
HAS NO HERO. The post header is the top of the page and is a plain div.section.u-pb-0, not a <header>. Listed in NO_HERO_TEMPLATES.
Slots that exist: title, 1-3 tag pills, a forced 1:1 cover, the rich-text body, 3 related cards. Nothing else.

Slots deliberately absent: author, date, read-time, share, breadcrumb, back-to-blog, deck, subtitle, excerpt, inline CTA, next/prev. Zero <time> elements exist on the original. Do not add fields the original lacks.
The related-posts grid uses the WIDE .container, not .cc-narrow, so it is wider than the prose above it. Deliberate.
CONTENT PROVENANCE: the real titles, covers and tags are genuine; the article bodies in the clone are original placeholder prose, deliberately not the original articles.

legal-prose.name: Legal document
legal-prose.sharedByVerification: Grouped after confirming both routes render the identical single component (LegalDocument) with the same three-node shape, differing only in which document module they pass and in their declared per-route link repairs. Verified directly in src/pages/TermsOfUse.jsx and src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.jsx.
notes: HAS NO HERO. Listed in NO_HERO_TEMPLATES.
Both routes are lazy-loaded behind Suspense in the real router.

OPERATIVE LEGAL TEXT. assetRole legal.operativeText is pinned to must-not-fabricate. The section exposes a documentRef enum and NO body field, so a PageSpec cannot carry legal prose and a generator has nothing to fabricate into. Requires sign-off from whoever owns legal/content before any real deployment.

auth-login.name: Log in (app host)
notes: SEPARATE DESIGN SYSTEM. The app host is a Vite + React + Mantine SPA, not Webflow. This template renders NO marketing nav and NO footer — it is the only template with neither, which is why chrome.navbar's mustBeFirst and chrome.footer's mustBeLast are scoped to marketing templates.
Its tokens live in tokens/themes/auth-light.json under a separate namespace and must never be merged into the marketing set.
HAS NO HERO. Listed in NO_HERO_TEMPLATES.
DELIBERATELY INERT: no action, no method, no endpoint, no fetch, autocomplete="off", submit only preventDefault()s. Any generated instance must never acquire credential submission.
SCOPE REDUCTION: /sign-up and /welcome were built and then removed on purpose by explicit decision. They must NOT be reintroduced as templates. Only /log-in is a local route.

not-found.name: Not found (stub)
notes: HONEST EVIDENCE LEVEL: stub, not measured. The original is a Webflow site-level 404 that recon never visited, so there is no measured structure for it.
The clone ships a deliberate one-paragraph placeholder. Recorded at its real evidence level rather than dressed up as a designed page.
A generator must not invent a 404 layout out of the marketing vocabulary.
It sits inside the chrome='site' layout route in the real router, so it does get the site nav and footer.
not-found.routeNote: React Router catch-all: <Route path="*"> inside the chrome="site" layout route.
